overview_text: The Bachelor of Science in Health Science and Law is designed for students who anticipate working in careers that have frequent involvement with lawyers and/or in heavily regulated areas. Students will attain knowledge and skills that are highly valued across health professions. This major will also be helpful for students who are interested in law school.
